item.title: Court denies DOJ access to D.C. voter rolls
item.description: A federal judge on Thursday blocked the Justice Department's request to review the District's complete voter list, determining that the administration's request was not justified.

item.title: President's military options severely constrained
item.description: Relying on a single individual for professional military advice is irresponsible and limits strategic options.

item.title: Princeton study reveals vulnerability in Georgia's ballot secrecy
item.description: A Princeton researcher demonstrated that Georgia's supposedly anonymous ballots can be linked to individual voters using only public data.

item.title: Smithsonian criticized for prioritizing activism over history
item.description: The American History Museum's current exhibits focus on anger and ideology, neglecting authentic historical narratives.
